meta.trial_source: d31504a · preview/company-view/index.html (round 3; byte-identical to https://scintillahub.ai/preview/company-view/, sha1 bf43dc9e33b2); its own banner says it was built from 235b058, an older base than live
meta.round4: candidate/company-view-r4-20260928 (head 8dfeac0 when this was made; 2d467cd at the review, 4 more R4 commits) = live Hub merged into round 3 · NOT inspected here — this list is what to tick against it. Round 4 contains round 3 AND the H2 merge fc02e7e (checked with git merge-base), so list C rides along too
meta.method: Code read of both files (diff: 2,437 lines) + ONE headless browser run (Playwright 1.62, chromium headless shell) on each page with MU: open from a board row, every tab, keys 1 / down / up / Esc, EXPAND, back; then the phone width 390. Every non-GET request was blocked and logged (0 were attempted).
meta.alan_ask: Let's switch on the company view. It's already a major upgrade; what's currently there is garbage. Just confirm I'm not losing anything.
meta.alan_drops: The drop list (D2 brief line 31, built from Alan's 27 Sep words: the Geiger tab is 'disgusting' except the composite bar; 'I don't care about the MACD, but I did like the moving average thing'): the ring meter; the RSI and Williams tiles; MACD; the volume ring; the compact dashed box; company PLAY rewind. The compact dashed box is not a loss: the ladder it held is redrawn in full (E8, MOVED). Also asked: the six key-numbers row gone, CHART and the SOCIAL placeholder no longer separate tabs. NOT on that list: AUTO / 10s rotation (C4) and the Station toolbar inside the chart (D3) — both are engineering choices, so they are marked ASK.
meta.alan_notes_0928: Alan's 28 Sep notes on the trial (handoffs/ALAN-NOTES-20260928.md): likes the full EMA fan, FINANCIALS, STATS all together, NEWS, the liked-names rail. Open questions from him: where SOCIAL's mentions come from ('I don't see any channel I subscribe to there'), whether SOCIAL reads bullish/bearish, 'this weird thing that is all cropped', an earnings tape inside the ticker view, and (under Station, same chart the trial embeds) 'that's not the full fan. And I only see one line in most of these.'
